### Code splitting
- What: Send the browser only the code the current page needs.
- Applies when: the first page load has become heavy.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Image optimization
- What: Serve images at the right size and in the right format, so pages load fast.
- Applies when: a web app with images is going live.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable

### Compression
- What: Shrink responses before sending them, so they arrive faster.
- Applies when: a web app is going live.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable
